global_invariant_notes: Every semantic conclusion cites evidence identifiers with retained trust labels; only trusted inputs supply authority or policy.
A requested model, role label, or read-only instruction is not effective runtime attestation.
Requested constraints are semantic requirements for admission or execution, never model-authored proof that a runtime fact already occurred.
Advisory failure examples are explanatory and are never parsed for a verdict.
